name: system_notice
label: System Announcements Table
description: The system announcement table is used for reporting scenarios related to framework status tracking and time dimension statistics.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: status
fields.description: not_issued: not issued; issued: issued; stopped: stopped.

fields.name: pop_up
fields.description: Longshow: persistent pop-up; close: non-persistent pop-up.

fields.name: ignore_read
fields.description: The "ignore_read" field is set to 1 for yes; 0 for no; -1 for not set.

fields.name: issue_time
fields.description: Last time the configuration was deployed. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_issue_time
indexes.description: Standard index covering the issue_time field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
